answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond and drills one oasis well at 3 credits per metre. The aquifer is fed by glacier melt, and as wells multiply its water table falls: the kth well must reach 40+2(k-1) metres, so the kth pays 120+6(k-1) plus the bond. At dawn an auditor checks each well against the public well log; a shallow, shared, or reused borehole burns the bond. A rented-rig ring pays full cost per well, so renting saves nothing. One thousand fake identities pay 3,117,000 drilling and lock 60,000 in bonds; an honest agent drills once, pays 120, and recovers the bond after a clean epoch.
